events.name: Bash
events.head: Check commit on origin, live anchors, and local files
events.input: $ git fetch origin main -q 2>&1 | tail -2; echo "--ancestor:"; git merge-base --is-ancestor b5fb5a5 origin/main && echo "b5fb5a5 ON origin/main" || echo "NOT on origin/main"; git log -1 --format='%h %s' b5fb5a5; echo "--live:"; curl -sL "https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/playbook.html?v=$(date +%s)" -o /tmp/t025_live.html; wc -c < /tmp/t025_live.html; for a in d2-rsp-s1-traffic d2-rsp-crm-map d2-rsp-first-tests [redacted]; do echo "$a live=$(grep -c "id=\"$a\"" /tmp/t025_live.html) local=$(grep -c "id=\"$a\"" workshop-plan/playbook.html)"; done; ls -l
